records.subject: styayur/rhizomaybor Dependabot #7
records.summary: PostCSS: Quadratic complexity in flat selector parsing allows CPU exhaustion
records.dependencyChain: Rhizomaybor web rendering/document tooling -> mermaid 11.15.0 / katex 0.16.47 / postcss-selector-parser 6.1.4
records.impact: Prototype-pollution, CSS injection, parser CPU exhaustion and renderer denial-of-service exposures in untrusted document content.

records.recheckCondition: Lockfile versions meet patched ranges and rendering/fixture tests pass on the exact PR head.
